ranked_facts.why: The presence of striae, rounded face, central obesity, and a fat deposit on the upper back is more characteristic of Cushing's syndrome due to an endocrine disorder with excess hormone production, which is a key feature of B1, than of the other candidate branches.
The elevated free T4 levels are more consistent with a hereditary disorder with endocrine tumors, such as B3, which can include thyroid abnormalities, than with the other candidate branches.

ranked_facts.concept_key: elevated serum cortisol after 2mg dexamethasone suppression test
ranked_facts.why: The elevated serum cortisol after 2mg dexamethasone suppression test is more consistent with Cushing's Syndrome due to an adrenal tumor, which is a type of endocrine disorder with excess hormone production, than with other candidates.

ranked_facts.concept_key: no significant central-to-peripheral ACTH gradients on inferior petrosal sinus sampling
ranked_facts.why: The absence of significant central-to-peripheral ACTH gradients on inferior petrosal sinus sampling suggests that the source of excess ACTH is not pituitary, which is less consistent with Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia Type 1 (MEN1), a hereditary disorder with endocrine tumors.
